segments.title: Resident Evil 4 Playthrough — Island Chapter
segments.notes: Case Blackwell streams a solo playthrough of Resident Evil 4 (Remake) as Leon Kennedy, navigating the island facility, battling Regeneradors and pirate shooting galleries, while fielding chat and referencing network lore.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors a solo gaming broadcast playing Resident Evil 4, narrating combat, puzzles, and pirate shooting galleries while referencing network storylines.

storylines.beat: [02:16:02] Case invokes Beyblade Burst as a mental focus technique during the pirate shooting gallery grind; [02:20:20] Sub goal reached — 'Beyblade Blurp' celebrated on air.

lore_notes.fact: Case confirms next scheduled news stream for 2024-04-04.
Patreon recording ('cream team') scheduled for 18:00 on stream day.
Broadcast concludes with a raid on NoMePro (Nomi Pro).

episode_summary: Case Blackwell pilots a three-hour Resident Evil 4 session from the island facility, wrestling Regeneradors, keycard puzzles, and a punishing pirate crossbow shooting gallery. A sub goal triggers a Beyblade Burst invocation, and the broadcast ends with a raid on NoMePro ahead of a next-day news stream and evening Patreon recording.
